name: File uploader
summary: A drop zone and button for adding files, with progress and a way to remove each file.

anatomy.purpose: Dashed area that accepts drops; the button inside is the real control.

whenToUse: Adding files to a form or a library.
whenNotToUse: Photos on mobile: let the system picker open.

accessibility.role: button that opens a file input; a list of files
keyboard: Enter or Space on the button opens the file dialog.
Remove buttons are in the tab order.
notes: Announce completed uploads and errors with a live region.
Show types and size limits before upload.
Remove buttons need labels: Remove report.pdf.

code.html:
Drop files here or

PDF or PNG, up to 10 MB
